Khi có động đất, bạn nên {x}.

lines.en: This is an earthquake drill. What should you do?
lines.vi: Đây là diễn tập động đất. Các em nên làm gì?

lines.en: Get under the desk and hold on.
lines.vi: Chui xuống gầm bàn và bám chặt.

lines.en: Good. Why shouldn't we use the lift?
lines.vi: Tốt. Tại sao không nên đi thang máy?

lines.en: Because it can stop, and we can get trapped.
lines.vi: Vì nó có thể dừng lại, và mình bị mắc kẹt.

lines.en: Excellent. And when the shaking stops?
lines.vi: Rất tốt. Còn khi hết rung thì sao?

lines.en: We walk calmly to the playground.
lines.vi: Mình bình tĩnh đi ra sân trường.

lines.en: Let's make an emergency kit for the rainy season.
lines.vi: Mình chuẩn bị bộ đồ khẩn cấp cho mùa mưa nhé.

lines.en: Water, food, a torch and a first aid kit.
lines.vi: Nước, thức ăn, đèn pin và hộp sơ cứu.

lines.en: Should we pack a radio too?
lines.vi: Mình có nên mang theo đài không ạ?

lines.en: Yes. The radio will warn us if there's a flood.
lines.vi: Có. Đài sẽ cảnh báo nếu có lũ.

writing.target: Floods and earthquakes are natural disasters.
An avalanche is very dangerous for skiers.
In an earthquake, you should|We were|Our emergency kit has

text_en: Last Tuesday, Nam's class was having a maths lesson when the alarm rang.
The teacher told everyone not to panic.
All the children got under their desks and held on to the legs.
After one minute, the teacher told them to leave the classroom.
They walked calmly down the stairs.
In the playground, the teacher counted the students.
The headteacher explained that earthquakes are sudden, so we must practise what to do.
Nam felt a little nervous, but he knew he would be ready.

questions.q: What were the children doing when the alarm rang?
Where did the children go first?
